title: Closed-unit localization triangle for an open-image composite
statement:
Use small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For a commutative condensed ring $R$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], put $R_T=p_T^*R$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Modules are internal $R_T$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]; $D(T,R)$ is their ordinary unbounded derived category with the actual derived direct images and inverse images [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Write $D^+(T,R)$ for the full subcategory with cohomology zero in sufficiently negative degrees. For an open immersion use the exact extension by zero [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek]. All inverse images below use the canonical identifications of the pulled-back coefficient rings.

Let $Y$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning locally Noetherian and quasi-compact [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Let $j:V\hookrightarrow Y$ and $b:W\hookrightarrow V$ be open immersions, let $h:H\hookrightarrow V$ be the reduced closed complement of $W$, and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow Y$ be any closed immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion]. For an $R_W$-module $M$, put $K=Rb_*M[0]$ and $B_M=Rj_*b_!M[0]$. These objects are bounded below. Use the actual closed unit $\eta_{h,K}:K\to h_*h^*K$ and the actual open counit $b^*Rb_*M[0]\xrightarrow{\sim}M[0]$. There is a distinguished triangle, natural in $M$,
$$i^*B_M\longrightarrow i^*Rj_*K\xrightarrow{i^*Rj_*(\eta_{h,K})}i^*Rj_*h_*h^*K\longrightarrow i^*B_M[1].$$
Its first arrow is obtained by applying $i^*Rj_*$ to the open counit $b_!b^*K\to K$, after identifying $b^*K$ with $M[0]$ by that counit; its second arrow is exactly the displayed closed-unit arrow. This is a triangle in $D(Z,R)$ for the specified internal-module functors, rather than only for their underlying cohomology sheaves. In particular, $i^*B_M=0$ if and only if $i^*Rj_*(\eta_{h,K})$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: The open subscheme V of the Noetherian scheme Y is Noetherian, so the open immersion b is quasi-compact. Apply condensed_open_closed_recollement only for its underived assertions that closed pushforward is exact, full and faithful. Its bounded-below triangles are not substituted for the required unbounded statement.

proof.text: Use the actual adjunctions a = D(b_!) ⊣ D(b^*) and d = Lh^* ⊣ Rh_*. The source extension-by-zero functor is fully faithful; therefore a has invertible unit. Closed pushforward preserves K-injectives as a right adjoint of an exact pullback. Full faithfulness descends to its right derived functor, so d has invertible counit. Transport the actual open derived adjunction along the canonical Lb^* ≅ D(b^*) comparison. The adjunction triple D(b_!) ⊣ D(b^*) ⊣ Rb_* gives invertibility of this transported counit. Its restriction to M[0] is precisely the isomorphism c in the statement, with the required formula definitionally.

source.place: Paragraph (3), closed-unit localization input; formal recollement argument using the adopted source library.

proof.text: The source internal-module open/closed API gives h^*b_! = 0 and joint detection of zero by b^* and h^*. Exact termwise pullback and extension by zero commute with homology. The canonical comparison Lh^* ≅ D(h^*) therefore promotes both assertions to the ordinary unbounded derived categories. If Lh^*K = 0, complete the open counit D(b_!)D(b^*)K → K to a distinguished triangle. Open restriction inverts it by the adjunction triangle identity and invertibility of the unit; closed restriction inverts it because both endpoints are zero. Joint detection kills the cone. Thus the counit is invertible and K lies in the essential image of D(b_!). This is a complete private Lean proof, not an additional assumption.

source.place: Paragraph (3), closed-unit localization input; formal recollement argument using the adopted source library.

proof.text: Apply the proved source-library Recollement.existsUnique_distTriang_counit_unit to these exact adjunctions, full faithfulness, mixed vanishing and essential-image criterion. Its triangle has literally the counit of a and unit of d. Choose its unique connecting map for each K. Recollement.exists_triangleHom applied to a morphism K → L gives the naturality equation for these choices, so they assemble into a natural transformation. Specialize to K = Rb_*M[0] and replace the first vertex by b_!M[0] using b_!c. The explicit triangle isomorphism proves that the first arrow is b_!(c inverse) followed by the open counit, while the closed-unit arrow is unchanged.

proof.text: Apply the actual triangulated composite F = Li^*Rj_* and its canonical shift isomorphism. Whiskering the preceding natural transformations produces a and delta in the statement. The image triangle is distinguished; its second arrow is exactly F applied to the actual closed unit, and the stated first-arrow formula holds definitionally.

proof.text: The existing source right-derived-functor t-structure API puts Rb_*M[0] in degree at least zero. Exact extension by zero commutes with the degree-zero embedding, so the same API puts Rj_*b_!M[0] in degree at least zero. Both bounded-below witnesses can therefore be chosen to be zero. Finally Mathlib Triangle.isZero₁_iff_isIso₂ applied to the distinguished image triangle gives precisely the requested zero/isomorphism equivalence.
